questions.prompt: How many total individual grains of long-grain white rice are produced by all commercial rice paddies across Thailand in a single year?
reasoning: Thailand produces approximately 20 million metric tons of milled rice annually.
One kilogram of dry white rice contains roughly 50,000 individual grains.
Multiplying 20 million tons (20 billion kilograms) by 50,000 yields 1 quadrillion grains.

questions.prompt: How many total individual letters are typed across all computer keyboards used in government offices in the United Kingdom during a single standard five-day work week?
reasoning: The UK civil service and government agencies employ about 500,000 public servants who use computers.
An average office worker types around 500 words or 2,500 characters per day, working 5 days a week.
Multiplying 500,000 workers by 2,500 letters per day gives 1.25 billion total keystrokes per week.

questions.prompt: How many total individual footsteps are taken by all participating runners who cross the finish line of the New York City Marathon in a single race year?
reasoning: Approximately 50,000 runners finish the New York City Marathon each year.
A marathon is 42.2 kilometres long, and an average runner's stride length is about 1 metre, requiring roughly 42,000 steps per runner.
Multiplying 50,000 finishing runners by 42,000 steps each yields 2.1 billion total steps.
